ambiguities.detail: API is Hono 4.13.7 on @hono/node-server: 14 chained .route('<literal prefix>', groupApp) mounts in apps/api/src/app.ts; routes declared via @hono/zod-openapi createRoute({method, path}) + app.openapi(routeDef, handler) — NOT app.get(). Standalone Hono detection is out of v0.1-alpha scope: routes[] is deliberately empty. A detector that only handles app.get() fails here; it must report the boundary, never fabricate routes.

src/main.ts: ROLE=worker runs the pg-boss worker (no HTTP server at all); otherwise serve() binds the port. Entry-point detection must follow the env conditional, else it reports routes for a worker process.

requireModule('<name>') returns 404 when the tenant hasn't enabled the module; per-route requirePermission gates writes. The static route set overstates what any tenant can reach — effective availability Unknown (tenant config runtime).
Route paths use OpenAPI {param} style ('/posts/{postId}'), converted by the library to :param. Conversion is library behavior (Inferred), not re-verified against @hono/zod-openapi source in-session.

entryPoints.form: serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: env.PORT }) from '@hono/node-server' — Hono has no app.listen; the adapter's serve() binds the port. Env-conditional: ROLE=worker -> startWorker() (no HTTP).
entryPoints.note: Named by package.json scripts (dev: tsx watch src/main.ts, start: node dist/main.js). App assembly (new OpenAPIHono()) in apps/api/src/app.ts.

excludedFacts.detail: Per-route createRoute method+path inventory not enumerated — Hono detection out of scope.
Webhook HMAC auth inside handlers; flushEventsAfterHandler event bus — runtime concerns.
